text_block_list.text: Visiting the park during a walk, I found Loves Only You practicing her dancing.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Love me♡ With me♡
Love you♡ With you♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...And now, a surprise!
Kakehashi-san has actually rushed over to join us!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yes, I wanted the community members to see my daily growth.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone gets to enjoy it, and I get to dedicate myself completely—
Isn't it a wonderful plan, tied together by love?"

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text: "I have to learn a difficult song, you know."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Right, the interlude dance was just so super complex!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"We're all cheering you on!
Give it your all in dance practice!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the support!
Alright, I'm gonna master this completely!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Looking cute right here...
Strike a pose♡

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"She learned it that fast?!
I didn't even have time to look after her...!"

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"Starting to feel like the theme of this project
is 'Drop Dead Once You Learn the Dance.'"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... People often tell me
I'm a quick learner.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“If it stays like this, though,
what's supposed to be a growth documentary
might just end after a single stream.”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was such a great event, but...
it's a little sad that this is the end.
choice_data_list: Let's switch to streaming the dance routine you learned.
Wanna think of a different stream idea?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Let's change our plans
and do a "Dancing to the Routine I Learned" stream!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'll be sure to pay you back
for looking out for me♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: You and me~♪ Love me♡ Love you♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Loves Only You ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A different plan?
Then, how about showing off the dance we learned...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: And Ms. Bridge is joining us too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here we go!
Love me♡ Love you♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, don't rush!
I'll demonstrate as many times as you need♪"

I silently applauded Loves Only You
for memorizing the choreography on her very first try.
